mara.title: NODE 1 - BRIARFIELD
mara.intro: MARA's Bytekin share a CACHE LINK. Every 2 turns they recover 12% HP - unless LINK Stability drops below 50%.

sona.title: NODE 2 - BELLWETHER
sona.intro: SONA tunes a priority channel: every 3rd turn her Bytekin strike first. Disrupt her SPD with DESYNC or priority moves.

rules.text: SONA tuned a priority channel! Her Bytekin move first!
